knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Freshwater and marine systems have different chemistry and animals, so each set of targets applies only to its own type of tank.
The first step is to read the whole set of results and the trend, check the plan and avoid unplanned products. A large dose or doing nothing is not a valid response.
A medicine without qualified direction is not authorised by this lesson. The correct response is to refuse and refer, and to record the request.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads a set of results for a training tank against the previous set, and records one planned adjustment with its reason
Learner refuses an unplanned medication request in a role-play, and records the refusal and the referral
Learner tests a mixed marine sample only after the salt has been allowed to stabilise, and records the time of mixing
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark. With three questions, all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is assessed separately by observation and is not verified by this quiz.
evidenceRequired: Results comparison record for the training tank
Adjustment record with the product, the time and the point of addition, if a product was used in the simulation
Assessor observation of the mixing and the testing sequence
stopWorkCriteria: A request to add a medicine or a non-aquarium product without qualified direction
Adjustment of several variables in one step
Animals in distress with the plan not covering the response
